summary_zh: 题目和参考评审本身没有问题，只改了一处说法：原文说“在持锁状态下循环调用 submit 的初稿会在第一个多条目的批次上死锁”，实际上只有一个条目的批次也会死锁，已改成“第一个非空的批次”。

issues.where: 参考解答 与助手协作
issues.problem_zh: 原文说在 with self._lock: 里循环调用 self.submit(...) 的初稿“会在第一个多条目的批次上死锁”。实测只含一个条目的批次同样死锁：第一次调用 submit 就要再取同一把不可重入的锁，和批次里有几个条目无关；只有空批次才能正常返回。
issues.change_zh: 把“第一个多条目的批次”改为“第一个非空的批次”（英文版同步修改）。

issues.problem_zh: 原有检查没有覆盖“持锁调用 submit 会死锁”这条说法。
issues.change_zh: 新增一条检查：用只含一个条目的批次运行这种初稿写法，确认线程一直卡住、不会返回。

checked: ran page (both languages) before and after the edit
compared the reference submit_many against a model (all-or-nothing, pop order equal to sequential submit) on 5000 random batches, lists and generators
stress-ran submit_many from 6 threads with overlapping batches, 200 trials: every id created once, no partial batch
ran the lock-then-self.submit draft on batches of size 0, 1 and 2: size 1 and 2 both deadlock, size 0 returns
applied PR #4's diff to jobqueue.py and ran the existing tests (5 pass), confirmed the shared metadata dict and the bare KeyError for an unknown policy name
confirmed PR #1's original leaves the first n-1 jobs in the queue on a duplicate
confirmed pickle.load on a JSON snapshot raises UnpicklingError, and json.dump of a dataclass payload raises TypeError
checked code blocks are identical in README.md and README.zh.md

code_run.notes: Both languages pass. The added check asserts the behaviour the corrected sentence describes (a one-item batch hangs); the code under test did not change, so the check contradicts the old sentence rather than failing against old code.
